tasks.title: Prepare an optional one-way tracker projection
tasks.goal: Only after explicit owner demand, derive a tracker export from accepted project facts without making the tracker authoritative.
steps: Confirm this optional atom was activated by explicit owner demand; otherwise leave it conditional with no product changes.
Bind the exact tracker destination/schema and project fact source; design a one-way export plan with stable external keys, expected revisions and scoped effects.
Use existing M-07 authority and M-16 idempotency/operation contracts; expose preview and conflicts without sending messages or remote writes.
positive_cases: A demanded projection has deterministic stable keys and reviewable one-way changes.
Existing remote revision matches are captured as preconditions.
negative_cases: No tracker value overwrites authored Vibe intent or acceptance.
Absent demand, destination binding or current authority prevents execution.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-publish target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.
acceptance: Exact optional export preview is inspectable and contains no credentials.
The tracker is clearly a projection, not a personal plan or truth database.
tasks.safe_stop: Optional preview is ready only if demanded; otherwise atom remains inactive, not a programme blocker.

tasks.title: Apply only an approved tracker batch idempotently
tasks.goal: If the optional export is demanded and its exact batch approved, perform and independently verify the one-way write.
steps: First prove idempotency/conflict/partial-error behavior against a local fake tracker using the prepared plan.
For a real demanded export, require the existing exact current-A batch receipt, then revalidate destination/revision/policy immediately before effects.
Apply only those effects, observe actual remote state and retain per-item completion/recovery; stop on interference instead of overwriting.
positive_cases: Same-key retry attaches to the same export without duplicate records.
A current approved exact batch updates only its selected projection.
negative_cases: Stale revision, revoked authority or changed plan has zero new writes.
Pending/declined approval is not a completed export.
